description:
We are a passionate group of B.Tech students driven by curiosity, caffeine, and the thrill of turning wild ideas into working prototypes. Currently deep into our engineering journey, we love bridging the gap between classroom theory and real-world problem-solving.
Our Interests & Skills:
Our core strengths lie in full-stack web/app development, Python, C/C++, data structures, and problem-solving. We are heavily interested in AI/ML, IoT, and building scalable, user-centric software products.
